name: LED Magnifying Lamp, 90 mm Lens, Table Top
tagline: LED magnifying lamp with a 90 mm lens and a 12 dioptre inset lens, tilting lens, folding arms, table top.
description: The Vartech 268 L is a table-top LED magnifying lamp with a 90 mm round lens (3 dioptre) and a small built-in 12 dioptre lens for closer inspection. The lens tilts and rotates, a lid protects it when not in use, and the folding arms reach out to 450 mm. It runs from 220 V mains and weighs about 1 kg. A compact lamp for inspecting micro components and densely populated PCBs.
